name: od-plugin-authoring
title: Plugin authoring
description: Guided scenario for creating a local LCT plugin folder that can be added to My plugins.

query.en: Create an LCT plugin for {{pluginGoal}}. Produce a folder named generated-plugin with SKILL.md, lct.json, and any useful examples or assets. Follow docs/plugins-spec.md and finish with a readiness summary plus next actions: Add to My plugins, Publish repo, or LCT PR.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{pluginGoal}} 创建一个 LCT 插件。请生成名为 generated-plugin 的文件夹，包含 SKILL.md、lct.json，以及有用的 examples 或 assets。遵循 docs/plugins-spec.md，并在最后总结它是否可以添加到 My plugins，同时给出下一步操作：添加到 My plugins、发布仓库或创建 LCT PR。

inputs.name: pluginGoal
inputs.default: a reusable workflow described by the user's prompt
inputs.label: Plugin goal
inputs.placeholder: turn a brand brief into a launch landing page workflow
